module: Third version of the rally driveline: turns the recce recording into an editable spline, then into a list of final points. Pipeline: loads the raw points (DrivelineRecording.load), simplifies them with the RDP algorithm into spline nodes, computes the smoothed terrain-snapped geometry (zSnap.conformSplineGeometry, with or without raycast), then generates the final points (position, quaternion, normal, simulated ts at 5 Hz). Can also save/load the spline (JSON), load the old final driveline, draw the debug/editor traces, project two positions onto the driveline to get the points or the distance between them, and read the properties (speed limit, allocated liaison time). The module returns a constructor: require(...)(missionDir).
usage:
local dl = require('/lua/ge/extensions/gameplay/rally/driveline/drivelineV3')(missionDir)
if dl:loadDrivelineFromFile() or dl:loadFromRecording() then
  local pointList = dl:getFinalPointList()
end
notes: Properties (self.properties): speedLimitKph (100 by default), liaisonAllocatedTimeMins (5), useRaycast (false), vertRayRaise (2.0, clamped to [0.1; 20]). They are saved in the spline file along with 'stats'.
The ts time of the final points is simulated: index / 5.0 (5 Hz), it is not the actually recorded time.
loadDrivelineFromFile: if the spline file exists it is used, otherwise falls back to the old final driveline file (converted to a spline).
The simplification forces a constant width (DrivelineUtil.defaultSplineWidth) for all nodes.

calculateDistanceBetweenPoints returns 0 if the final driveline is not available. The distance is measured along the driveline with projection (xnorm) for the partial start and end segments; the order of p1 and p2 does not matter.
Files are chosen via rallyUtil.drivelineSplineFile(missionDir) and rallyUtil.finalDrivelineFile(missionDir).

C.desc: Driveline V3 returned by the constructor. Attributes: missionDir, rawDrivelinePoints, spline, finalDrivelinePoints, simplificationTolerance, properties, stats.

init.desc: Stores the mission folder and initializes the state (default simplification tolerance, default properties, no data loaded).

createEmptySpline.desc: Creates an empty spline table ({name, id, isDirty, isEnabled, isLoop, nodes, widths, nmls, divPoints, divWidths, tangents, binormals, normals, discMap}). The id is a UUID if absent.

loadPropertiesFromData.desc: Reads data.properties (speedLimitKph, liaisonAllocatedTimeMins, useRaycast, vertRayRaise) with default values.

serializeSpline.desc: Serializes the current spline into a JSON table {version=1, name, isLoop, nodes, widths, nmls, properties, stats}. Returns nil if fewer than 2 nodes.

loadSplineFromData.desc: Builds the spline from JSON data (nodes, widths, nmls, properties, stats). Fails if fewer than 2 nodes or an invalid node.

data.desc: Data read from a spline file.

saveSplineToFile.desc: Writes the spline to the mission's spline file (folder created if needed).

loadDrivelineSplineFromFile.desc: Loads the spline from its file, computes its geometry and generates the final points.

loadRecceRecording.desc: Loads the raw points recorded during the recce (DrivelineRecording.load) into rawDrivelinePoints.

loadFinalDrivelineFromFile.desc: Loads the old final driveline (list of [x,y,z] points, at least 2) and turns it into full points; also reads the properties.

loadDrivelineFromFile.desc: Loads the driveline from a file: spline if present, otherwise the old final driveline converted to a spline then regenerated.

loadFromRecording.desc: Full pipeline: loads the recce recording, converts to a spline, computes the geometry, generates the final points.

convertDrivelineToSpline.desc: Converts driveline points to a spline: positions, constant width, normals; RDP simplification (simplificationTolerance tolerance). Logs the reduction ratio.

drivelinePoints.desc: Points {pos, normal?}; rawDrivelinePoints by default. If provided, they replace rawDrivelinePoints.

updateSplineGeometry.desc: Recomputes the spline's secondary geometry (subdivided points divPoints, tangents, normals...) conforming to the terrain via zSnap.conformSplineGeometry, and its roadLength length.

returns.desc: false if no spline or fewer than 2 nodes.

createDrivelinePointsFromPositions.desc: Converts a list of positions into full points: orientation (quatFromDir from the direction toward the next point), ts = index/5, prev/next/id chaining, normal (SnaproadNormals.forwardNormalVec), empty pacenoteDistances and cachedPacenotes.

returns.desc: Points, nil if fewer than 2 positions.

createDrivelineFromSpline.desc: Generates finalDrivelinePoints from the spline's subdivided points (divPoints). Sets finalDrivelinePoints to nil if the spline is not ready.

getFinalPointList.desc: Returns a PointList built from the final points (nil and a warning if there are fewer than 2).

deepCopySpline.desc: Deep copy of the spline (nodes, widths, nmls and simple metadata) for undo/redo in the editor. Does not copy the secondary geometry.

renderRawDriveline.desc: Draws (debugDrawer) the raw points: pink-purple cylinders between points and small vertical stakes. Call every frame.

renderSmoothCurve.desc: Draws the smoothed curve (divPoints) as a blue prism the width of a vehicle.

lineWidth.desc: Prism width in m (1.945 by default).

renderFinalDriveline.desc: Draws the final points as semi-transparent red cylinders with stakes.

renderSpline.desc: Draws the editable spline (rSpline editor tools) with start and end markers; for a single node, draws the node's sphere.

getLiaisonAllocatedTimeSecs.desc: Time allocated for the liaison, in seconds (liaisonAllocatedTimeMins x 60).

_findSegmentRange.desc: Projects p1 and p2 onto the final driveline's segments (closest projection) and returns the ordered segment range: startIdx, startXnorm, endIdx, endXnorm (the start always comes first). nil if unresolved.

getPointsBetween.desc: Ordered list of the final points covering the interval between p1 and p2 (segment endpoints included).

calculateDistanceBetweenPoints.desc: Distance along the final driveline between the projections of p1 and p2 (partial start and end segments computed with xnorm).
